hook: AI gave me a 7-step framework when I asked how to apologize to my friend.
caption:
AI gave me a 7-step framework when I asked how to apologize to my friend.

Step 1: Acknowledge the impact.
Step 2: Take responsibility.
Step 3: Express empathy.

I stopped reading at Step 3.

Here's the thing — I didn't need a framework. I needed two sentences I could actually say out loud without sounding like a LinkedIn post.

The AI wasn't wrong. It just didn't know me.

It didn't know I communicate better in writing than speech. It didn't know I over-explain when I'm nervous, so shorter is always better for me. It didn't know the friendship is 11 years old and we skip the formal stuff.

This is the gap nobody talks about. AI is trained to be helpful to everyone, which means it's optimized for no one in particular.

A BootFile fixes that. It's a personal instruction profile — built around how YOU think, process, and communicate — that travels with you into every conversation.

Same question. Totally different answer.

The calibrated version? Four words she'd actually recognize as mine.

That's the difference between AI that impresses you and AI that actually works for you.
